values.note: Burt Township's 2026 campsite fees: Other Electric $50 a night, Lakefront $55, Prime Lakefront $60 (weekly 7x, 30 days $1,500-1,800); primitive (tent) sites $30. One rate for everyone, no resident split. Campspot adds the park's $5 'Reservation Fee' once per stay (read 2026-10-13). Cancelling 31+ days out costs $20.

fees.source: https://burttownshipacmi.gov/recreation/woodland-park-campground/ ('2026 Campsite Fees': Prime Lakefront $60, Lakefront $55, Other Electric $50, Primitive $30 nightly) + the 2026 policy PDF (cancellation) + Campspot quote in audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl ('Reservation Fee' $5), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 'May stay open later weather permitting' - in late October 2026 the township says it is still open, weather permitting, with no online booking; call the office.

season.source: https://burttownshipacmi.gov/recreation/woodland-park-campground/ ('Campground Opens: April 15', 'Campground Closes: October 15. *May stay open later weather permitting'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The township says 167 campsites. Campspot sells 79 RV sites (Electric + Water 52, to 45 ft; Lakefront 22, to 45 ft; Prime Lakefront 5, to 40 ft; all back-in, all open to motorhomes) and 38 primitive park-in / walk-in tent sites. The township doesn't say what the other sites are (it also runs first-come emergency sites and employee camping). Extended stays may take at most a third of the campground.

sites.source: https://burttownshipacmi.gov/recreation/woodland-park-campground/ ('Woodland Park has 167 campsites!') + Campspot site types for campspot.com/book/grandmaraismichigan (sites, max length, rig types; audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, read 2026-10-13) + the 2027 extended-stay flyer, read 2026-10-25

values.note: Showers free for campers. Limited Wi-Fi only at the office, pavilion and community center. No sewer at the sites: a local septic vendor offers pump-outs. Generators, hose splitters and amp converters are prohibited.

facilities.source: https://burttownshipacmi.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/2026-Woodland-Park-Policy-pdf-002.pdf ('Showers are no charge for woodland park campers', 'Non-Camper Dump Fee is $20.00', 'Limited Wi-Fi is available! Data points ... at the park office, pavilion, and community center', 'Individual pump out service is available from a local septic vendor') + 2026 brochure ('Laundry available in East bathhouse'; prohibited: generators, hose splitter, electric amp converters), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 'We are now all reservations!' - booked on the township's Campspot page; regular reservations for the coming season open Feb 1 at noon (2027: Feb 1, 2027), extended stays (21-night minimum, no refund on the first 21 nights) on Jan 4. A few first-come 'emergency' sites are sold from 9 AM for no more than 2 consecutive nights. Online booking closes at the end of the season.

booking.source: https://burttownshipacmi.gov/recreation/woodland-park-campground/ ('We are now all reservations!', Make a Reservation -> campspot.com/book/grandmaraismichigan) + 2026 policy PDF ('Emergency First Come First Serve Sites are only intended for emergencies. No more than 2 consecutive nights') + 2027 extended-stay flyer ('Regular reservations (no min. night requirement) go live Feb 1, 2027. 12pm'; '21 night minimum'), read 2026-10-25

summary: Burt Township page, 2026 policy PDF, brochure and the township's own Campspot engine: confirmed $50-60 (2026; $5 reservation fee) and 50-amp; added April 15 - October 15 season, 167 sites (79 Campspot RV sites to 45 ft), showers/laundry/dump/limited wifi, Campspot booking opening Feb 1 with a few emergency FCFS sites. Extended stays capped at a third of the campground, so not seasonal in character. Phone matches. Discounts (military, from the Good Sam directory) not stated by the township; left. --AWH note kept unchanged.
